freeHelp.title: Turn2Us - Advice Finder - IPSEA - Independent Parental Special Education Advice -
freeHelp.blurb:
IPSEA offers free, independent, legally based information and advice for parents and carers of children with SEN and disabilities in England and Wales. Key contact: IPSEA Advice Line (phone and online guidance) for issues like LA duties to assess/provide, exclusions, and discrimination.  
- Phone: 0300 222 5899  
- Website: ipsea.org.uk/contact (book an appointment; up to 30 minutes per session)

freeHelp.blurb:
Summary for user query: LawWorks pro bono legal advice contact phone UK

- University of Law Legal Advice Centre (London) ULLAC offers free initial legal advice for people in need who cannot afford legal help or are not eligible for legal aid.
- Areas covered:
  - Family law (initial advice only; includes child contact, divorce, parental responsibility, etc.; no casework or court records)
  - Smal
